dataset.name: JaGOOD MVP Commodity Profiles
dataset.purpose: Provide commodity inputs for route-risk inference and scenario simulation.
dataset.preprocessing: No automated external-data ingestion. Values were manually curated as hackathon assumptions and are loaded without numerical transformation.
limitations: These profiles are demonstration assumptions, not observed shipment outcomes.
The values have not been validated for regulatory, food-safety, or commercial decision-making.
Shelf life and delay tolerance are simplified model inputs and must not be presented as guaranteed remaining product life.

sources.title: JaGOOD hackathon MVP commodity assumptions
sources.notes: Internal manually curated assumptions. This source is not FoodKeeper and is not a real-world measurement dataset.

commodity_type.method: Manually selected Indonesian commodity labels for the MVP.

temp_ideal_min_c.method: Manually curated storage-temperature assumption; no external record-level lineage is available.

temp_ideal_max_c.method: Manually curated storage-temperature assumption; no external record-level lineage is available.

shelf_life_hours_at_ideal_temp.method: Manually curated hackathon assumption used as a relative risk feature.

delay_tolerance_hours.method: Manually defined operational threshold used by the synthetic label function.

temp_sensitivity_level.method: Manually assigned Low/Medium/High category used by feature engineering.
